Name: Empty Your Hands
Author: Hikari014
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
Deselect your active item/tool when you press the configured key (default X).

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
In [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] you can find these options:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Keyboard[/font] : The key to use when you play using keyboard. Default X.
[*][font=Courier New]Controller[/font] : The button to use when you play using controller. Default Left Thumbstick.
[*][font=Courier New]EnableReselectOldToolPosition[/font] : Reselect tool position to where it was prior emptying hands when you switch items with mouse scroll wheel or controller right/left trigger button. Default true, but you should turn this off and report to me if you experience any weird behavior.
[/list]
You can configure the key binding to use multiple key combinations; for example, if you want the hotkey to be a combination of Left Alt + X, you can edit it like this:

[code]"Keyboard": ﻿"LeftAlt + X"
[/code]
GMCM does this automatically for you, but if you prefer editing it directly, you can refer to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]Key Bindings[/url] to see the list of possible keys.

Keep in mind that even though it is possible to use multiple key combinations in the [font=Courier New]Controller[/font] option, I don't really think that's a good idea since I don't know very well every button function and am playing Stardew with mouse and keyboard.

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
This mod is compatible with:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can change the configuration in the GMCM config menu.
[*]Any mods that do not conflict with this mod's functionality﻿.
[/list]
Although 99% of mods should be compatible, there's a slight chance that it may not work correctly. In that case, please refer to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19736?tab=bugs]Bug Reports[/url].

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]See also[/b][/size][/color]
[url=https://github.com/Hikari-BS/StardewMods]Source code[/url].

[color=#b6b6b6][size=2]This mod was inspired by Oblitus/quicksilverfox's [i]long-lost[/i] Empty Hands. It was no longer available on Nexus; only the [url=https://github.com/quicksilverfox/StardewMods]source code[/url] is available on GitHub. I just took the logic behind it, re-simplified it, and integrated it with GMCM. To wherever you are, whether or not you're still active in the Stardew community, thank you![/size][/color]
